title: Meta- and Google-backed Jio Platforms’ shares soar over 21% on trading debut after record IPO
summary_full: Jio had offered 270 million shares in the IPO priced at 1,119 rupees apiece, raising 302 billion rupees ($3.2 billion) in the country's largest-ever IPO.
